name: atlasclean-cdk
description: AWS CDK infrastructure for AtlasCleanAI Enterprise

scripts.deploy:staging: cdk deploy AtlasClean-staging --require-approval never --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/atlasclean.ts" -c stage=staging
scripts.deploy:production: cdk deploy AtlasClean-production --require-approval never --app "npx ts-node --prefer-ts-exts bin/atlasclean.ts" -c stage=production
